task: [Project: Indigo/api-gateway] Format error responses for the Indigo API gateway.

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Indigo] Error responses follow RFC 7807 (Problem Details): {type, title, status, detail, instance}; no custom error envelope.
[Project: Indigo] The type field must be a URI pointing to the error documentation in https://docs.indigo.internal/errors/{code}.
[Project: Nova] Error responses use a custom envelope: {error: {code, message, request_id}}; Nova predates RFC 7807 adoption.
candidate_memories.notes: note: scope=Nova; different format, conflicts with Indigo if injected

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Atlas] Errors are returned as plain HTTP status codes with no body for internal APIs; Atlas clients parse status codes only.
[General] RFC 7807 is the recommended standard for REST API error responses; projects may have project-specific adaptations.
candidate_memories.notes: note: general recommendation, Indigo-specific format is authoritative

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Indigo] New API gateway version 3.2 adds native RFC 7807 middleware; migration guide is in docs/gateway-v3-migration.md.
